Catalog number : I00046 Uniform title: Aṃśumattantraśaṅkhābhiṣekam Manuscript : IFP manuscript bundle RE31392 Description: RE31392, Aṃṥumattantra-Śaṅkhābhiṣekam. This bundle comprises a significant work called Śaṅkhābhiṣekam from the Aṃṥumattantra. There are Kṣīrasnānavidhi from the Dīptāgama, Gaurīmaṇḍapapūjāvidhi, Dhvajārohaṇavidhi from the Kāmikāgama, Bherītāḍanavidhi, Utsavavidhi. The Śaṅkhābhiṣekam is a Kāmyapūjā (a worship performed with a specific rituals). The ritual is especially performed during the annual festival of the deity. The ritual is considered as one of the most auspicious ceremonial on Rohini, Pūsam, and Ṥuba Nakṣatras in the tithi table, and as well as on Saturdays, Thursdays, and Fridays in the week days. Conches are of three types: male, female, and neuter. They are further classified into four types: Brahmin, Kṣatriya, Vaiṣya, and Ṥudra. The manuscript goes on to elaborate on the importance of conches and the special pūjās associated with them.Physical Attributes:Size: 38.8✕3.5 cm.Folios: 29.Lines per Folio: 11–13. ॥ amśumattantram ॥ śaṅkhābhiṣecanavidhiḥ
(p.3b, f1a, l.1) śaṅkhābhiṣecanaṃ vakṣye śrūyatāṃ ...saktamaṃ । āyuśrīmṛtyu jayadaṃ vyādhināśaṃ... । ...kāmamokṣāṃ ca...*putirapautravivardhanam । * (l.2) śāntikaṃ puṣṭikaṃ proktaṃ sarvapāpavināśanam ॥ tasmāt sarvaprayatnena śaṅkhatoyābhiṣecanam । ... (l.3) rohiṇyāṃ śanisaṃyukte gurupuṣya tathaiva ca ॥ ādityahastasaṃyukte bhṛguveti saṃyute । kuje...*samāyukte budhānurādhakepi ca । * (l.4) somavaiṣṇava saṃyukte yajamānānukulataḥ ॥ aṣṭamyāñca ...*śyamāvāsyāñca saṃkrame । * (l.5) yayajamānasyajanmarkṣe kuryāt śaṅkhābhiśecanam ॥ śaṅkhantrividhamityuktaṃ *pumānnārīnapuṃsakam । * (l.6) mūlasthūlaṃ bhavennārī agrasthūlantu pusakam ॥ agramūlaṃsamañcettu *puṃliṅgamitikīrttitam । * (l.7) śaṅkhañcaturvidhaṃ jñeyaṃ brāhmaṇādikrameṇa tu ॥ ...cāpikasatbhāvandadyāgra...*dhiṣṭhitassamam । * (l.8) udaraṃ pūrayitvā tu brahmaśaṅkhamihocyate ॥ kṣatriyaṃ śaṅkhamevantu puruṣatpīta...tathā । (l.9) mūladīrghaṃ laghuścaiva vaiśya śaṅkhamitismṛtam ॥ śūdraśaṅkhaṃ laghuścaiva dīrghraṃ hrasthapṛṣṭhakam । (l.10) śaṅkhalakṣaṇamevoktaṃ śaṅkhottavamataḥ puram ॥ tāṃbraparṇyotbhavaṃ śaṅkhamuttameñceti kīrttitam । gaṅgāyāṃ madhyamañcaiva narmadāyānu kanyasam ॥ evaṃ trividhamityuktaṃ śaṅkhot(d)bhavamihocyate । (p.4a, l.1) dakṣiṇāvarttakaṃ śaṅkhaṃ jātiśreṣṭhamiti smṛtam ॥ tat śaṅkhaṃ madhyame sthāpya śaṅkhāṃśca paritonyaset । (l.2) pūrvoktalakṣaṇecaiva āmukenaiva pūrayet ॥ tadardhamadhyamaṃ caiva tadardhamadhamaṃ bhavet । dakṣiṇāvarttakaṃ śaṅkhaṃ svakaṃ*mānaṃ vidhīyate ॥ * (l.3) pūjāgrehe marakamādyaiḥ darśitañcāti sundaram । sahasraśaṅkhāṃ saṃsthāpya uttamaṃ cetikīrtitam ॥ (l.4) śaṅkhañca śatasaṅkhyāca madhyamaṃ ca krameṇa tu । śaṅkhamekonapañcāśat kanyasaṃ ca iti kīrtitam ॥ (l.5) evaṃ krameṇa vidhivat snapanoktavadarcayet । athavān upakāreṇa śaṅkhatoyābhiṣecayet ॥ (l.6) vighneśvaraṃ samabhyarcya puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥ । pañcagavyañca saṃsthāpya pañcāmṛtamathācaret ॥ (l.7) snapanaṃ kārayeddhīmān pūrvavat vidhimācaret । pādyamācamanaṃ cārghyaṃ pṛthak pātreṇa vinyaset ॥ (l.8) jalabhāṇḍañca saṅgṛhya jalenāpūrayettataḥ । tadravyeṇaiva saṃyuktaṃ sugandhakusumādibhiḥ ॥ (l.9) mukhaṃvastreṇa saṃveṣṭya sthāpayettu vicakṣaṇaḥ । śaṅkhapūjāvidhānārthaṃ ...gre sthaṇḍilaṃ nyaset ॥ (l.10) vighneśvaraṃ samabhyarcya puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥ । śaṅkhañca kṣālayet dhīmān tuṣā... । (l.11) śaṅkhapādatrikoṇañca ...meva... ॥ (l.12) (l.13 damaged) (p.4b, l.1) ....aśvini devatā । rekhasya lakṣaṇaṃ...ca śaṅkhāgre sarasvatī ॥ śaṅkhañca ...*īśvarādi śirontañca saptasvarañca ...tṛta । * (l.2) pātradhārānyet madhyetadardha...śaṅkhakaṃ nyaset । (l.3) nāḍīsantānamārgeṇa tatvatrayaṃ samarcayet । rāgoniyati vidyā ca kalākālā ca ...(mohakam) । vidyādīśvara*sādākhyaṃ śaktitraya iti smṛtaḥ ॥ * (l.4) gandhatoyena samyojya aṣṭagandhañca vinyaset । candranāgarūkarpūraṃ māla*jalakuṅkumam ॥ * (l.5) uśīraṃ koṣṭhasamyuktaṃ śaivaṃ gandhāṣṭakaṃ nyaset । elañca gandhadvāretimantreṇa candanañcaiva vinyaset ॥ (l.6) śivagāyatrimantreṇa agarūñcaiva vinyaset । śanno devīti mantreṇa karpūrañcaiva vinyaset ॥ (l.7) kitavāsetimantreṇa tamalañcaiva vinyaset । tatvāyāmeti jalakuṅkumaṃ nyaset ॥ (l.8) nākesuparṇyamantreṇa uśīraṃ kuṅkumañcaiva vinyaset । trimūrtametimantreṇa ra...koṣṭhañcaiva tu vinyaset ॥ (l.9) kūrccena mathanaṃ kṛtvā yadvādevāyeti mantrataḥ । dhyātvā bhāgīrathīṃ madhye ardhāṅgaṃ caturaṅganīm ॥ (l.10) kṛtāñjalipuṭobhūtvā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām । taraṅgavastrasamyuktāṃ pīnonnata ghanastanām ॥ (l.11) dhyāye्t gaṅgāṃ samāvāhya dhūpadīpaṃ samācaret । śaṅkhapūjāvasānetu jalapātraṃ samarcayet ॥ (l.12) śālibhisthaṇhilaṃ kṛtvā patma(dma)maṣṭadalaṃ likhet । (p.5a, l.1) tripādaṃ madhyame sthāpya tadardhepātrakama nyasetam ॥ (l.2) vastreṇānū samāveṣṭyā gandhatoyena pūrayet । navatīrthaṃ samāvāhya sugandhañca sumādibhiḥ ॥ dhūpadīpaiḥ *samabhyarcya dvārapūjārcanaṃ tataḥ । * (l.3) sthāpayitvā tu tadrṛvyaṃ tailābhyāṅgaṃ tu kārayet ॥ kāṣṭamāmalakañcaiva *rajanīñcaiva lepayet । * (l.4) snānatoyañca saṃsthāpya pañcagavyāmṛtairapi ॥ gandhatoyābhiṣekānte(le) *mantrapuṣpañca bhāvayet । * (l.6) pāyasānnaṃ nivedyañca vastragandhañca dāpayet ॥ śaṅkhābhiṣecanaṃ kuryāt *rudrasūkteṇa mantrataḥ । * (l.7) camakaṃ puruṣasūktañcaśrīsūktaṃ pāvamānakam ॥ ācāryaśaṅkha mudhṛtya liṅgāgre caturaṅgulam । tajjalaṃ srā(śrā)vayet dhīmānanyeśca snāpayet tataḥ ॥ (l.8) tattat saṅkhyāvasāne tu arcayet tu vicakṣaṇaḥ । snānaṃ vastrañcagandhañca puṣpadāmatathaiva ca । (l.9) naivedyañcaiva tāmbūlaṃ dhūpadīpantathaiva ca ॥ ṣoḍaśaivopacārantu sandhyāṃ *pratimācaret । * (l.10) śivakumbhañca saṅgrāhya paricārakamūrdhanī ॥ harmya pradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt sarvālaṅkārakārasamyutam । (l.11) garbhagehaṃ praviśyātha śivāgre sthaṇḍilopari ॥ kubhāt bimbe samādāya *liṅgamadhye tu vinyaset । * (l.12) śivabījañca vardhanyā piṇḍikāyānyavinyaset ॥ (p.5b, l.1) snāpayet liṅgaṃ vardhinyā kumbhāstu piṇḍakāḥ । na...kumbhāt (l.2) ...ścaiva vinyaset... । to datvā mantrāntu nivedayet । evaṃ bhrameṇa vidhivat sandhyāśeṣaṃ (l.3) anyamācaret ॥ e...taimartyumasapuṇyāṃ gatimāpnuyāt । ityamśumāntantre śaṅkhābhiṣeka*vidhiḥ paṭalaḥ ॥ * (l.4) kṣirasnānam tataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kṣīrasnānavidhikramam । āyurārogyaphaladaṃ *sarvavyādhināśanam ॥ * (l.5) putrapautrābhivṛdhyarthaṃ lokaṃ śāntikaraṃ bhavet । saṅkīrṇañca vikīrṇañca *samyogañca tridhābhavet ॥ * (l.6) pūrṇaṃ kṣīraṃ parigrāhya sthāpayedvidhinā saha । etat saṅkīrṇamityuktaṃ *vikīrṇañca tata śruṇu ॥ * (l.7) śivāṅgārū samānīya śrāvayet svānave ghaṭe । dhāroṣṇadasamāyuktaṃ *sthāpayet liṅgamūrdhani ॥ * (l.8) ekadvikīrṇa saṃjñeyaṃ saṃyogassatataśruṇu । yājñikai vṛkṣamādāya *yācatuṣpādāni kalpayet ॥ * (l.9) liṅgopari daśāṅgulaṃ catuṣpādyuccrayaṃ smṛtim । tanmadhye padmamālikhya *tanmadhye suṣiraṃ bhavet ॥ * (l.10) tanmadhye tu nyaset dhīmān kṣīrakumbhaṃ saratnakam । etat saṃyogamityuktaṃ śānti*homa samanvitam ॥ * (l.11) gāvaśivāpurāt pañcakṣitaṃ prāptāḥ śivārcane । nandā bhadrāca sumanā surabhiḥ suśīlakā ॥ (l.12) kapilā kṛṣṇa dhūmravarṇā ca raktā śvetā tathaiva ca । nandā(bhadrā) sumanā tasyāt varṇametat prakīrtitam ॥ (p.6a, l.1) devānāṃ yajanārthāya sarvavot hitāya ca । gāvomātāsthitā subhadrānārthantu śivāya ca ॥ (l.2) goṣudevāsthitā nityaṃ gobhiryajñaṃ pravartate । brahmāviṣṇustathānityaṃ bhṛṅgamūle sthitā bhavet ॥ (l.3) śru(śṛ)gāgre tu sthitasti kumbhasthāvaraṃ jaṅgamākaram । lalāṭe ṣaṇmukhaṃ proktaṃ grīvāmadhye sthito haraḥ ॥ (l.4) kābālāścaturān nābhau tathā puṭasamāśritau । karṇayoraśvinau devāḥ candrārkau ca cakṣuṣi sthitau ॥ (l.5) danteṣu māruto devā jīvāyāṃ varuṇasthitaḥ । sarasvatī ca huṃkāre yamayakṣau ca gaṇḍayoḥ ॥ (l.6) khuramadhyeṣu gandharvāḥ khurāgreṣu ca pannagāḥ । khurāṇāṃ paścimāgreṣu parāṇāṃ gaṇāstathā ॥ (l.7) daśarudrā daśānāḍī sthāpayet savyasiddhiṣu । śroṇitaṭasthāḥ pitaro urastasyā umābhavet ॥ (l.8) śrīvarāne gavā nityaṃ rāśayastvaṅgulāḥ tathā । ādityaraśmayo vālā gomūtre *jāhnavī tathā ॥ * (l.9) kuṣayaśca tathā sarveśvarāmatu behyava sthitāḥ । ...vitarā ....tā । (l.10) catvārassāga...gavāṃ yeca paye... । yadvat vīrya jagat kiñcintat jñeyaṃ kṣīrasaṃtaca? । tasmāt sarva prayatnena kṣīrasnānaṃ samācaret ॥ (l.11) iti dīpta śāstre kṣīrasnānavidhi paṭalaḥ navādi sahasrantaṃ... oṃ ... । (p.6b, l.1) dhātrī sarasvatīcaivā mahālakṣmī mṛḍā tra(ta)thā । dūrgā kāntyā ca mohinyā uṣā devī ca sundarī ॥ (l.2) bhuvaneśī tathā karṇā mahāmantraikarūpiṇī । yoginī vā(cā)pavidhvaṃsi bindurūpī ca sarvagā ॥ (l.3) saṅgrāmaṇi jayacchaktiḥ āpaghnījayarūpiṇī । vaiṣṇavī bhakta poṣāca brahmātmakāmarūpiṇī । sukhāsīnī *patma(dma)vatī dravyarūpī caṇyagā ॥ * (l.4) kṛpālinī mahāsenā tārā dvātrimśadevatāḥ । puṃ devatānāṃ sarveṣāṃ *parivārāṣṭavimśakāḥ ॥ * (l.5) sarvāsāmapi
